items.title_en: Norwegian mayor travels 4,300 km across India in autorickshaw: ‘So down to earth’
items.title_zh: 挪威市长乘坐机动三轮车穿越印度 4,300 公里：“脚踏实地”
items.summary_en: In a viral clip, a Gujarati man who appears to have met Jo Inge Hesjevik during a stop in the state introduces him to the camera, pointing out that he is a mayor back home.
items.summary_zh: 在一段广为流传的视频中，一名古吉拉特男子似乎在该州停留时遇见了乔·英格·赫斯耶维克，他向镜头介绍了他，并指出他是家乡的市长。

items.title_en: At 61, woman holds plank for 5 hours, breaks her own world record

items.summary_en: DonnaJean Wilde took on the gruelling challenge, remaining in the plank position as the hours passed and eventually completing the five-hour mark.
items.summary_zh: 唐娜·吉恩·王尔德 (DonnaJean Wilde) 接受了这项艰巨的挑战，随着时间的流逝，她一直保持平板支撑姿势，最终完成了 5 小时的任务。

items.summary_zh: 机长斯米特·马赫查尔透露，在他的副驾驶据称袭击了他之后，他在努力保持飞往特拉维夫的航班飞行时背诵了《哈努曼查利萨》。

items.title_en: Rare two-headed baby turtle discovered with ‘two distinct personalities’
items.title_zh: 罕见的双头小海龟被发现具有“两种截然不同的性格”
items.summary_en: The tiny two-headed diamondback terrapin weighs just 5.2 grammes (Picture: Cape Wildlife Center/Cover Images) A rare baby turtle has been discovered with two heads – and seemingly two distinct personalities. The tiny diamondback terrapin weighing just 5.2 grammes was found at a protected nesting site in Wellfleet on Cape Cod, Massachusetts, in the US . items.title_en: ‘Give me iPhone password’: Dehradun woman says thief contacted her after stealing phone
items.title_zh: “给我 iPhone 密码”：德拉敦女子称窃贼在偷手机后联系了她
items.summary_en: Kaushiki Dhyani, who shared her ordeal on Instagram, said her iPhone was stolen from Clement Town on September 12.
items.summary_zh: Kaushiki Dhyani 在 Instagram 上分享了她的遭遇，她说她的 iPhone 于 9 月 12 日在克莱门特镇被盗。

items.title_en: Nana Patekar dies at 75: ‘Control Uday’ and other iconic memes that won over millennials and Gen Z
items.title_zh: 娜娜·帕特卡 (Nana Patekar) 去世，享年 75 岁：“控制乌代”和其他赢得千禧一代和 Z 世代青睐的标志性模因
items.summary_en: As the film industry and millions of fans mourn the actor’s death, we have compiled a list of iconic Nana Patekar movie moments that became memes.
items.summary_zh: 在电影业和数百万影迷哀悼这位演员的去世之际，我们整理了一份成为模因的娜娜·帕特卡标志性电影时刻清单。

items.title_en: ‘The Orange Plague’: Naked Trump statue unveiled near European Parliament
items.title_zh: “橙色瘟疫”：特朗普裸体雕像在欧洲议会附近揭幕
items.summary_en: Created by Danish sculptor Jens Galschiøt, the eight-foot-long sculpture depicts US President Donald Trump holding a golf club in one hand and the scales of justice in the other.
items.summary_zh: 这座八英尺长的雕塑由丹麦雕塑家 Jens Galschiøt 创作，描绘了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普一手拿着高尔夫球杆，另一只手拿着正义的天平。

items.title_en: Archaeologists In Egypt Just Found A 1,900-Year-Old Ring Depicting The Lighthouse Of Alexandria
items.title_zh: 埃及考古学家刚刚发现了一个 1,900 年前的戒指，描绘了亚历山大灯塔
items.summary_en: C. Gerigk/F. Goddio/Hilti Foundation Archaeologists in the Eastern Harbor of Alexandria discovered a rare bronze ring engraved with an image of the Lighthouse of Alexandria. Excavations taking place in the Eastern Harbor of Alexandria, Egypt have recently recovered pottery and glass artifacts, as well as a rare bronze ring emblazoned with an image of the Lighthouse of Alexandria.
items.summary_zh: C.格里克/F。戈迪奥/喜利得基金会考古学家在亚历山大东部港口发现了一枚罕见的青铜戒指，上面刻有亚历山大灯塔的图像。最近在埃及亚历山大东港进行的挖掘工作发现了陶器和玻璃文物，以及一枚罕见的刻有亚历山大灯塔图像的青铜戒指。

items.title_en: Ishi, The ‘Last Wild Indian’ Who Entered Modern Society — Then Died From Tuberculosis Five Years Later
items.title_zh: 伊什，进入现代社会的“最后一个野印第安人”——五年后死于肺结核
items.summary_en: Public Domain Ishi, the California Yahi man who was known as the “last wild Indian.” In 1911, a starving Native American man walked out of the wilderness near Oroville, California. He wouldn’t speak his own name, but anthropologists referred to him as Ishi. Ishi was seemingly the last surviving member of the Yahi tribe, a subgroup of the Yana people who once lived near the Sierra Nevada Mountains of California. items.title_en: The Chilling Crimes Of Béla Kiss, The Hungarian World War 1 Soldier Who Murdered Nearly Two Dozen Women
items.title_zh: 第一次世界大战期间，匈牙利士兵贝拉·基斯（Béla Kiss）谋杀了近两打妇女，其令人毛骨悚然的罪行
items.summary_en: Public Domain Béla Kiss, the Hungarian soldier who murdered at least 24 people in the early 20th century. In 1916, police officers in Cinkota, Hungary, made a horrific discovery on the property of a local tinsmith named Béla Kiss: the corpses of one man and 23 women. They were stuffed into metal drums, and several had puncture wounds in their necks and the blood drained from their bodies. Kiss had seemingly begun his killing spree in 1903.
items.summary_zh: 公共领域 Béla Kiss，匈牙利士兵，在 20 世纪初杀害了至少 24 人。 1916 年，匈牙利辛科塔的警察在当地一位名叫贝拉·基斯 (Béla Kiss) 的锡匠的财产中发现了可怕的发现：一名男子和 23 名妇女的尸体。他们被塞进金属桶里，有几个人的脖子被刺伤，血从他们的身体里流出来。 Kiss 似乎从 1903 年就开始了他的杀戮狂潮。
